description: Open source repositories with NO BOUNTIES that still credit reporters with CVEs (GitHub CNA or MITRE), ordered by newest stable release first.

repos.name: ghostfolio/ghostfolio
repos.description: Self-hosted web application for tracking personal investment portfolios across multiple accounts, covering stocks, ETFs and cryptocurrencies, built as an Angular frontend on a NestJS and Prisma backend. No bug bounty: the security policy asks only that findings be emailed to security[at]ghostfol.io and offers no reward or swag, and the project has no HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti, YesWeHack or huntr program and no Internet Bug Bounty coverage; fixes ship as GitHub security advisories with CVEs assigned by the GitHub CNA that credit the reporter by name (e.g. CVE-2026-28785, reporter ratrarity). Latest stable release: 3.41.0 (2026-08-03, 19:03 UTC).

repos.name: OpenCTI-Platform/opencti
repos.description: Open source cyber threat intelligence platform from Filigran for storing, correlating and sharing threat knowledge on a STIX 2 data model, exposing a GraphQL API over Elasticsearch, Redis and RabbitMQ with a large connector ecosystem. No bug bounty: the security policy states that Filigran does not and has no plans to offer any bug bounty, swag or other reward, offering public credit instead, and no program exists on HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti or YesWeHack; the same policy commits maintainers to requesting the CVE themselves, and advisories carry GitHub CNA CVEs that credit the reporter by name (e.g. CVE-2026-44730, reporter Wachizungu). Latest stable release: 7.260803.0 (2026-08-03, 16:20 UTC).

repos.name: ToolJet/ToolJet
repos.description: Open source low-code platform for building internal tools, dashboards and workflows through a drag and drop builder, with connectors for more than 80 data sources on a React frontend and a NestJS backend. No bug bounty: the security policy is a single line directing reports to security@tooljet.com with no reward, the vendor security page offers no payout, and there is no HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti, YesWeHack or Internet Bug Bounty coverage; reports are published as GitHub security advisories with CVEs assigned by the GitHub CNA that credit the reporter by name (e.g. CVE-2026-55413, reporter sha1cybr). Latest stable release: v3.20.205-lts (2026-08-03, 16:14 UTC), newest on the supported LTS line; the parallel -beta tags are marked pre-release and were excluded.
